summary.intent: Close the single verification gap (GAP-01) from Phase 20 by removing dead vault migration code, then execute and verify the gap-closure plans.
summary.outcome: Two gap-closure plans (20-05 API cleanup, 20-06 client cleanup) were created, executed, and verified successfully. All 9 verification truths passed, GAP-01 resolved, Phase 20 marked complete.

repo: The vault v2 blob format is now canonical — no non-migrated users exist, making all PATH B (DB decrypt + lazy migration) code dead.
The vaults table previously had three crypto columns (encrypted_root_folder_key, encrypted_root_ipns_private_key, migrated_at) that were dropped as part of this cleanup.
New user vault init now publishes a v2 blob to IPFS immediately, making vaults IPFS-native from day one with no DB fallback.
The API client was regenerated after DTO simplification — downstream clients now only see ownerPublicKey + rootIpnsName.
5 prior-phase test suites (143 tests) continued to pass after the migration code removal — no regressions.

code.finding: Verification file recorded 9/9 truths verified and GAP-01 resolved after gap-closure execution.

workflow: The planner agent committed the gap-closure plans itself (commit bd236c59a), so the orchestrator's attempt to commit was a no-op — worth detecting this earlier to avoid redundant git operations.
Pre-wave dependency check was skipped because key-links were in plan body rather than frontmatter — the check only reads frontmatter, so body-level dependencies are invisible to it.
Verification file path resolution required multiple fallback bash checks when the verifier wrote to a different working directory than expected.

friction: Verification file location was ambiguous — the orchestrator ran ~6 bash commands to locate the VERIFICATION.md after the verifier agent completed, suggesting path resolution between agents is fragile.
The orchestrator attempted to commit plans that had already been committed by the planner agent, requiring a redundant git check.
open_items: Desktop Rust types were simplified (InitVaultRequest crypto fields removed, non-migrated branch in fetch_and_decrypt_vault removed) — worth confirming all Rust consumers updated if additional desktop builds exist.
Recovery tool export-file message was updated for permanent v2 format — the nature of the message change should be communicated to users relying on recovery exports.
Key-links in plan bodies (rather than frontmatter) are invisible to the pre-wave dependency checker — consider whether body-level wiring should be surfaced to the checker.
